$comment: The lens return contract. Passed to `claude -p --json-schema` by lib/run-panel.sh, so the shape is FORCED rather than requested. Before this file the shape was prose in agents/qa-manager.md and a coin toss in practice: agents/qa-reviewer.md prescribes a markdown round-note, the spawn prompt asked for JSON, and whichever won varied by run. Measured on the Phase 1 parity replay -- the -p arm returned markdown and failed the only criterion it failed. Every required key below is one a consumer actually reads (lib/round-return.sh, lib/attribute-findings.sh); nothing is here speculatively. There is deliberately NO markdown blob: references/round-note.md renders from the MERGED findings, so per-lens prose would be output tokens nobody reads.

navigation.$comment: Read by lib/round-return.sh into the verdict's lens_navigation map. Self-reported, and known to be unreliable on its own -- a lens once reported cmm+ctx while making zero CMM calls -- so it is a claim to cross-check against lens-models-actual.json, not evidence.

schema_change_detected.$comment: Read by lib/round-return.sh; ORs across lenses and arms the Step 3E schema gate. Dropping it silently un-arms that gate, which is why it is required rather than optional-with-a-default.

contract_verification.$comment: The contract-security lens OWNS this table; other lenses emit [].

title.$comment: Carried into the round note and the observations ledger.

area_file.$comment: Repo-relative. lib/attribute-findings.sh blames this path to decide qa_introduced; an absolute path or a bare basename defeats attribution silently.

status.$comment: Only `confirmed` findings block. A hypothetical is reported, never acted on.

evidence.$comment: The 4-axis prose agents/qa-reviewer.md already requires per finding. It lives in the finding rather than in a separate markdown blob so the note renderer gets it from the merged set.
